mapper.select: select year as year, month as month, sum(ifnull(rent,0)) as rentSum, sum(ifnull(principal,0)) as principalSum, sum(ifnull(interest,0)) as interestSum, sum(ifnull(deposit,0)) as depositSum, sum(ifnull(consulting_fee,0)) as consultingFeeSum, sum(ifnull(pay_amount,0)) as payAmountSum from budget_plan_cost_detail_project where deleted = 0 and budget_plan_cost_id = #{budgetPlanCostId} and data_category = #{dataCategory} group by year,month
